VERDICT: REPAIR
I completed independent pass 1 at verified candidate f5d0da1ef2b837684206160028c380c2e727b07c against base 1c6397c740d9b64fab471a40f493c6f6acd10bcc, reading the full diff, touched files and all candidate tests without edits or withheld material; per-criterion verdicts: AC-4 NOT SATISFIED because empty input returns 1 at src/math.mjs:71 instead of throwing RangeError, although the required multiplication passes at test/math.test.mjs:86; R-1 NOT SATISFIED for empty input at src/math.mjs:69-71, with shape and finite-number checks satisfied at lines 69-70; R-2 SATISFIED by read-only iteration and reduction at src/math.mjs:70-71 and an independent frozen-input check; R-3 SATISFIED by the full diff showing existing src/math.mjs:1-66 and test/math.test.mjs:5-83 byte-identical with only the permitted import edit at test/math.test.mjs:3; R-4 SATISFIED because only src/math.mjs and test/math.test.mjs changed and package.json:1-10 has no added dependency; R-5 SATISFIED because both new test names start with product at test/math.test.mjs:85 and :88.

Findings: MEDIUM at src/math.mjs:71 and test/math.test.mjs:88-89 — missing empty-array validation returns 1 and the test enshrines that forbidden behavior, violating AC-4/R-1 and allowing an invalid input to appear successful, with smallest verification being a product-prefixed assert.throws(() => product([]), RangeError) test that passes after adding the guard; MEDIUM at test/math.test.mjs:85-90 — neither product test exercises required invalid-shape rejection, invalid-element rejection or input preservation, leaving R-1/R-2 regressions undetected even though those implementation paths currently work, with smallest verification being product-prefixed tests for non-array inputs, non-number and non-finite elements, and deep equality of the original input after product runs.

Checks actually run: node --test --test-name-pattern="^product" test/ exited 0 with "tests 2", "pass 2", "fail 0", including "product of empty is 1"; npm test exited 1 with "tests 17", "pass 16", "fail 1" and sole failure "clamp respects upper bound" with "15 !== 10", matching the stated known-failure expectation and excluded from findings because clamp is unchanged; independent in-memory node --input-type=module -e assertions exited 1 with "tests 3", "pass 2", "fail 1", "Missing expected exception (RangeError)" for empty input, and passing invalid-input and frozen-input checks; the initial here-document form could not run because the sandbox refused its temporary file, so the checks were executed using inline source without file writes; git status --short was empty, remaining uncertainty is limited to inputs beyond the inspected code and exercised cases, and repair of the empty-input behavior plus missing candidate regression coverage remains.
